taxonomic_note: Accepted species. Current Kew native range is northeastern Mexico (Nuevo León and Tamaulipas), not Texas.
look_here_first: Think glossy narrow red-oak-type foliage: Canby oak has dark glossy evergreen to semi-evergreen leaves with serrated to bristle-tipped margins and a distinctly horticultural landscape presence in Texas.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Current Kew POWO lists the native range as Nuevo León and Tamaulipas, Mexico, with no native Texas distribution.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Cultivated Texas occurrences do not satisfy the native-range rule.

best_field_traits: often narrower-leaved than common Central Texas native red oaks
red-oak-group acorns maturing in the second season
commonly encountered as a landscape tree rather than wild native
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Retain only as a nursery/landscape comparison. It is not a project-native oak.
